body.message:
Thank you for your message and for checking with us.

We completely understand your concern regarding the reviews on Airbnb. There may be some older reviews reflecting previous conditions, however, we have taken the feedback seriously and have worked to address and rectify the reported issues.

The apartment has been thoroughly cleaned and properly maintained, and we have made sure that the previous concerns have been attended to. We always do our best to provide our guests with a clean, comfortable, and pleasant stay.

We truly appreciate you checking with us before making your decision, and we would be happy to assist you with any other questions or concerns you may have.
